title: API Authentication & Authorization
brief: Add JWT-based auth, RBAC, API keys, rate limiting, audit logging, and security headers to the MCP server.

units.title: JWT token middleware
units.description: Create JWT middleware for issuing, verifying, and refreshing tokens. Support access + refresh token pattern. Environment-configurable secret and expiry.

units.title: Role-based access control
units.description: Define roles (admin, engineer, operator, viewer) with permission matrices. Implement RBAC middleware that checks role against required permission per route.
exit_conditions: Permission matrix covers all dispatcher categories

units.title: API key management
units.description: API key generation, storage (hashed), validation middleware. Support key rotation and expiry. For external integrations (CAM systems, ERP).

units.title: Rate limiting
units.description: Per-client and per-endpoint rate limiting using sliding window. Configurable limits. Return 429 with retry-after header.

units.title: Audit logging
units.description: Log all write operations with user, timestamp, action, parameters, result. Append-only audit log. Queryable by time range and user.

units.title: CORS policy + security headers
units.description: Configure CORS with allowed origins. Add security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, CSP. Helmet-style middleware.
